headline: MasTec (MTZ) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost As Analysts Weigh Guidance And Superior Group
summary: MasTec sits at the center of an active reassessment of price targets, with updated modeling work lifting fair value from about $349 to about $427. Behind that shift, analysts are weighing fresh guidance, the acquisition of The Superior Group, and a mix of bullish and more cautious views on how execution and segment pressure could affect valuation over time.
